<script id="report-user-feedback-v2">
(() => {
  const run = () => {
    const data = window.PORTFOLIO_REPORT_DATA || {};
    const NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
    const BLUE = '#2563eb', PURPLE = '#7c3aed', GRAY = '#64748b', ORANGE = '#f97316', RED = '#e11d48';
    const PALETTE = [BLUE, ORANGE, '#22c55e', RED, PURPLE, '#0891b2', '#ca8a04', '#4f46e5'];
    const finite = value => value !== null && value !== undefined && Number.isFinite(Number(value));
    const num = value => finite(value) ? Number(value) : null;
    const pct = value => finite(value) ? `${Number(value).toFixed(2)}%` : 'N/A';
    const ratio = value => finite(value) ? Number(value).toFixed(2) : 'N/A';
    const money = value => finite(value) ? (Number(value) * 10000).toLocaleString(undefined,{style:'currency',currency:'USD',maximumFractionDigits:0}) : 'N/A';
    const esc = value => String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
    const section = id => document.querySelector(`#${id}`);
    const chart = id => section(id)?.querySelector('.chart');
    const tableSlot = id => section(id)?.querySelector('.table-slot');
    const tip = document.querySelector('.tooltip') || (() => { const e=document.createElement('div'); e.className='tooltip'; document.body.appendChild(e); return e; })();
    const showTip = (event, html) => { tip.innerHTML=html; tip.style.display='block'; tip.style.left=`${event.clientX+14}px`; tip.style.top=`${event.clientY+14}px`; };
    const hideTip = () => { tip.style.display='none'; };
    const svgEl = (tag, attrs={}, text='') => { const el=document.createElementNS(NS,tag); Object.entries(attrs).forEach(([k,v])=>el.setAttribute(k,String(v))); if(text!=='')el.textContent=String(text); return el; };
    const records = name => data.tables?.[name] || [];
    const optRows = records('optimization_results');
    const assetByTicker = new Map(optRows.map((row,index)=>[String(row.ticker), {ticker:String(row.ticker), name:row.name || String(row.ticker), color:PALETTE[index%PALETTE.length]}]));
    const assetName = ticker => assetByTicker.get(String(ticker))?.name || String(ticker);
    const assetColor = ticker => assetByTicker.get(String(ticker))?.color || GRAY;
    const benchmarkLabel = data.benchmark_name || data.benchmark_symbol || 'Benchmark';
    const meta = data.metadata || {};
    const configMeta = meta.configuration || {};
    const coverageMeta = meta.data_coverage || {};
    const optimizedLabel = data.objective_name || 'Optimized Portfolio';
    const monthYear = value => { if(!value)return ''; const d=new Date(`${String(value).slice(0,10)}T00:00:00`); return d.toLocaleString('en-US',{month:'short',year:'numeric'}); };
    const period = (() => { const rows=data.portfolio_growth || []; if(!rows.length)return ''; return `${monthYear(rows[0].date)} - ${monthYear(rows[rows.length-1].date)}`; })();
    const effectiveRfPct = (() => { const p=(data.efficient_frontier||[]).find(x=>finite(x.expected_return_pct)&&finite(x.volatility_pct)&&finite(x.sharpe_ratio)); return p ? Number(p.expected_return_pct)-Number(p.sharpe_ratio)*Number(p.volatility_pct) : null; })();

    const style=document.createElement('style');
    style.id='report-user-feedback-style';
    style.textContent=`
      .feedback-note{font-size:12px;color:#64748b;margin:10px 0 0;line-height:1.5}
      .feedback-note strong{color:#334155}.feedback-table-note{font-size:11px;color:#64748b;margin-top:8px}
      .allocation-svg{width:200px;height:200px;margin:4px auto;display:block;background:transparent}
